lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Sb2Br2Cl8 (reduced formula K2SbBrCl4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Br centers in tetrahedral environments coordinated by four Cl neighbors, while K and Sb centers each have eight geometric neighbors; Sb is coordinated by four Br and four Cl, and K by four Br and four Cl. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Cl-centered octahedra and between Br-centered tetrahedra.
